title: Reward Basis Decomposition for Interpreting Preference Heterogeneity
venue: Interpretability as Science: Towards Rigorous Evaluation of Mechanistic Interpretability @ NeurIPS 2026
summary: Reward Basis Decomposition (RBD) separates shared population preferences from per-user directions, revealing whether reward models encode meaningful individual-level preference structure.

title: Uncertainty, Not Concealment: A Mechanistic Reappraisal of Sycophancy in Vision-Language Models
venue: Medical Reasoning with Vision Language Foundation Models (Med-Reasoner) @ NeurIPS 2026
summary: Uses probing, activation steering, and forced-choice diagnostics to show that on cross-modal conflicts, VLMs register uncertainty about the visual evidence rather than concealing a conflict they have detected.

title: Specification Drift in Multilingual, Multi-Turn LLM Interactions
summary: Audits whether models follow their own published specifications across multi-turn, cross-cultural conversations.

title: The Curious Agent: Can Intrinsic Curiosity Guide LLM Exploration?
summary: Investigating whether intrinsic-curiosity signals can help LLM agents explore what is learnable rather than chase noise, across inference, SFT, and GRPO.

title: Blockchain-Integrated Multi-Modal LSTM-CNN Fusion for High-Precision Epileptic Seizure Detection from EEG Signals
summary: Fusing LSTM and CNN branches over multi-modal EEG improves seizure-detection precision, with a blockchain layer keeping the underlying clinical records tamper-evident.

title: EEG Spectrogram Augmentation Using Transformer and Quantum-Inspired Generative Models for Epilepsy Classification
venue: IEEE Japan-Africa Conference on Electronics, Communications and Computations (JAC-ECC)
summary: Transformer and quantum-inspired generative models synthesize additional EEG spectrograms, improving epilepsy classification when labelled recordings are scarce.
